thread:
tanya: Heads-upmy partner's due date moved up and I need to bump my parental leave start by two weeks. We have an on-call rotation and a helpful chunk of feature work. Is there short-term childcare or backfill support?

roxanne: Big congrats! We have Emergency Family Support (up to $1k/mo reimbursement) and a Short-Term Backfill Loan (interest-free up to $5k). Which do you need? :party_parrot:

tanya: Likely a contractor for ~3 weeks, estimate $3.6k. Would that be loan territory?

sam: Yes, STB Loan fits. Quick process: manager signoff email to people-ops, complete internal loan form, include runbook and cost. People Ops approves; Finance reviews if >$3k. Payroll will set up payback deductions (default 6 months).

roxanne: Manager email should include: employee name, original leave dates and new dates, contractor estimate + rate, brief justification (why contractor), and handoff doc. Subject suggestion: "STB Loan request  Tanya backfill 2026-05-07 to 2026-05-28"

tanya: I can write a 1-page handoff and prioritized checklist tonight. Will my maternity pay be affected?

roxanne: No impact to statutory parental pay. Loan is separate and handled via Payroll deductions. Also note eligibility: employee must be active and >30 days tenure.

payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Once People Ops approves, submit the signed loan agreement to payroll@redwood.com with code STB-LOAN. Attach an ID scan for verification. Payroll will configure deductions aligned to pay cycles (default 6 months).

sam: TL;DR actions: 1) Tanya's manager (Roxanne) to email people-ops with runbook + contractor estimate + budget code. 2) People Ops routes to Finance for >$3k approvals. 3) On approval, sign agreement and submit to Payroll. 4) If needed, split cost across cost centers by specifying budget split in the manager email.

tanya: Thanks everyone. I'll send the manager email and cc people-ops now. Appreciate the fast response.

people-ops-bot: people-ops-bot: Reminder: these requests are confidential between People Ops, Payroll, and Finance. If asked externally, say "family leave transition support."
